Description: Manages native window lifecycles, IPC channels, multi-window undocking, and OS dialogs
Secure typed IPC boundary exposing filesystem, tag editing, sync, and volume management to renderer
Renderer UI for library browsing, sorting, search, metadata editing, playlist authoring, and undocked player view
Playback controller handling audio streaming, queue state, seek/skip/shuffle/repeat, and output sink selection
Local file reader, ID3 and Vorbis tag writer, embedded artwork extractor, and library indexer
Deterministic file renamer and folder restructuring engine applying car-compatible naming patterns
Removable drive synchronizer comparing hashes/timestamps, copying files, pruning stale tracks, and writing M3U playlists
Hosted web fallback presenting desktop application download, SHA-256 checksums, and installation guide
